mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every minimal B-reserve tight circuit T, the conversion graph from its distinct owned A diagonals to actual B edges outside the already occupied reserve has a matching of size |T|-rho_B(T).
would_close: the B-reserve deficit in every tight circuit
mechanisms.kill_test: Run the exact n=14 three-colour common-two-token circuit. Enumerate all target B edges licensed by the rectangle forcing rule; kill if no third distinct B atom is adjacent to an owned diagonal.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is an absolute congestion constant C such that every coherent family of distinct owned A diagonals can be mapped through the two-sided degree transport relation to actual missing B edges, with every B edge receiving at most C preimages and with the resulting quantitative bound sufficient for the 1/8 budget.
would_close: a quantitative A-to-B conversion after bounded congestion
mechanisms.kill_test: Use rectangular blow-ups with common B neighbourhoods. Measure maximum preimage multiplicity and kill if it grows with the number of owned diagonals or if the C-loss is too large for the frozen 1/8 inequality.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Whenever a minimal reserve circuit has one owned A atom whose conversion neighbourhood meets an unused B atom or an alternating reserve component with surplus one, an explicit alternating path increases the number of served colours by one without reusing any typed atom.
would_close: iterative payment of every B tight circuit
mechanisms.kill_test: On the n=14 tight circuit add each possible single conversion arc in turn; reject any purported augmentation that returns to an occupied token or changes the canonical full reserve K(e).

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After quotienting identical A diagonals, the owned rectangles of a family of coherent stars admit either a transversal into distinct conversion witnesses or a merged rectangle whose direct transference inequality pays the total unresolved B deficit.
would_close: cross-star overlap control for A-to-B conversion
mechanisms.kill_test: Glue two stars along one diagonal and then along an entire rectangle side. Kill if both the transversal and merged transference can fail while all inherited hard constraints remain feasible.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every hard maximum-witness graph there is a canonical set Sigma of exactly S_m nonnegative combinatorial slack atoms, each with an actual edge or missing-pair carrier, whose disjoint use reconstructs the maximum-witness edge ledger.
would_close: a carrier-level interpretation of the S_m budget
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the construction to the audited tight and paid n=14 swap pair with identical S_m. Kill if an atom changes type from A to B without a bijection, a negative atom remains, or |Sigma| differs from S_m.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The colourwise low-edge cancellation ledger admits an injection from every uncancelled outer-A atom contributing to R_A into a canonical slack carrier, and the injections for different colours have disjoint images.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate pairs of mixed-high and internal-only-low colour profiles sharing endpoints and anchors. Kill if two uncancelled atoms demand the same carrier or cancellation depends on processing order.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the canonical slack atomization, every outer-A demand set T satisfies rho_S(T)>=d_A(T), where d_A is the number of uncancelled colour-owned residue atoms, so Hall gives a simultaneous owned slack assignment.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use two tight circuits and two low colour classes all requesting one slack atom. The rank inequality must fail rather than allowing four local payments from one carrier.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If the anchored outer-A residue exceeds S_m, the labelled complex contains at least Phi(n,e) pairwise C7-compatible edges of distinct colours; hence the public colour target closes directly without converting A units into B units.
would_close: a direct Branch-A and outer-gate exit
mechanisms.kill_test: Test the three-clique-chain and n=14 hard-local models. Kill if R_A-S_m can be positive while every compatible labelled edge family stays below Phi and no inherited hypothesis is violated.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every owned diagonal belonging to a B tight circuit and lying outside A_<q* forces either a new mixed-high anchor of a previously unused colour or a direct non-rainbow C7; inside A_<q* the diagonal is charged injectively to the internal-low term of R_A.
would_close: a common-witness bridge from B circuits to the exact outer-A coordinate
mechanisms.kill_test: Place all owned diagonals of the n=14 circuit on each side of the q* threshold under degree-preserving perturbations. Kill if the same high anchor serves two diagonals or if a diagonal is invisible to both alternatives.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every inclusion-minimal blocker to R_A<=S_m contains an owned anticomplete rectangle whose exact low-edge or compatible-colour output strictly exceeds the blocker deficit.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate typed blockers of size at most four, preserving colour and high-anchor labels. Kill on a blocker whose only rectangles reuse one missing edge or whose output lies outside the blocker owner set.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The typed conversion system satisfies a min-max theorem in which every dual deficient set is bounded by rho_B plus the rank of an explicit A-to-B conversion relation plus rho_S, with separate target constraints; every hard graph meets all such inequalities.
would_close: simultaneous B and outer-A payment without scalar rank addition
mechanisms.kill_test: Instantiate the three-colour two-token circuit with three A owners but no conversion arcs. The oracle must report deficit one; kill if the formulation declares feasibility from rho_A+rho_B alone.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Typed circuit elimination can be chosen so that each step either adds a genuinely new B or slack carrier, merges two overlapping owned rectangles, or reduces the lexicographic pair of unresolved demand and distinct owner atoms; therefore the process terminates at a paid system or a direct outer-gate exit.
would_close: global conversion across overlapping tight circuits
mechanisms.kill_test: Run the abstract pair of crossing circuits sharing one B token and one A diagonal. Kill if elimination cycles, loses an owner label, or decreases scalar deficit only by spending the shared atom twice.
